SELECT emp_no, emp_name, emp_email, emp_dept_no, emp_position_no, emp_level, emp_state, emp_presence, emp_birth, emp_contact, emp_post, emp_address1, emp_address2, emp_ctime, emp_utime
FROM emp WHERE emp_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR emp_email LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY emp_no

SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, p.project_purpose, p.project_visibility, p.project_status, p.project_start, p.project_deadline, p.project_ctime, p.project_utime,
CASE WHEN pm.project_member_role = 'owner' THEN 'owner'
WHEN pm.project_member_no IS NOT NULL THEN 'member'
ELSE NULL END AS projectRole
FROM project p
LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON p.project_no = pm.project_no AND pm.emp_no = #{empNo}
WHERE p.project_status = 'active'
AND p.project_visibility != 'private'
AND ( p.project_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.project_purpose LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY p.project_ctime DESC

SELECT t.task_no, t.project_no, p.project_name AS projectName, t.task_title, t.task_content, t.assigned_member_no, t.task_status, t.task_order, t.task_start, t.task_end, t.task_category, t.task_priority, t.task_progress, t.task_writer_no, t.task_ctime, t.task_utime
FROM task t
LEFT JOIN project p ON t.project_no = p.project_no
WHERE p.project_visibility != 'private'
AND ( t.task_title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR t.task_content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ORDER BY t.task_ctime DESC

SELECT a.*, e.emp_name AS empName, p.project_name AS projectName
FROM attach a
LEFT JOIN emp e ON a.attach_uploader = TO_CHAR(e.emp_no)
LEFT JOIN project_file pf ON a.attach_no = pf.attach_no
LEFT JOIN project p ON pf.project_no = p.project_no
WHERE p.project_visibility != 'private'
AND a.attach_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY a.attach_no DESC
